news.title: Sen. Chris Murphy's stroke at 53 highlights a trend: Strokes among younger adults have risen
news.summary: Researchers found that the stroke incidence rate among adults from 1993-94 nearly doubled in 2020, jumping from 33.90 cases per 100,000 people to 62.18 cases.
